notes.title: Cyberdrifter - Release road map!
notes.content:
As pointed out in the community forums Cyberdrifter is now coming up to it's estimated 18 month early access window, this unfortunately will not be met but I can bring you up to speed on where I'm at and hope to be!

The good news is I have another 2 levels that are approx 75% complete, before releasing those I thought it was time to start adding the story/plot elements before players start asking themselves "why am I doing this"? Cyberdrifter was never intended to be just an arcade shooter.

I am currently finishing up development on the 0.6 update which adds plot to the current 5 levels and also introduces a Grav-gun which brings great functionality for puzzle elements that are also being introduced (nothing too taxing to break the flow).
I am aiming for 0.6 to be ready by the end of this month.

Now that I have a storyboard I am happy with I am aiming to release 3 more levels to complete the game, these will be slightly longer & more involved, combining gameplay elements learned previously. I will hold back at least one of those from early access for the full release.

Level 6 estimated release Nov/Dec 2018

Aiming for full release around May 2019 giving the game a 2 year development period.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Upcoming 0.6 story content details & beta news!
notes.content:
As the [b]0.6 story content update[/b] is gaining closer to completion, I am planning a beta for player feedback which will contain the new opening story plot/mission scenes and the new 'Grav gun' to test out in the [b]revamped[/b] tutorial & opening mission!

[b]Beta content & changes:[/b]
New opening title screen & story plot/mission scenes
Revamped tutorial & opening level
New visuals & new enemies with added tactics
The player is now equipped with a 'Grav-gun' that can manipulate objects & enemies from afar, as well as blast them!
The off-hand shield has been replaced - you can now 'grav' an enemy & use [b]it[/b] as the shield!
Holding/utilising an object with the hand that is simultaneously controlling the player doesn't feel intuitive & has been disarmed. The 'Grav Gun' has you covered!
Inky black walls with neon lighting was the vision but in reality facing a black wall in VR isn't a great experience so all black walls are now textured & lit for easier navigation.
Ammo/shield pick ups from enemies & dispensers are all 'grav' able, they can now come to you!
Vignette while moving option added.

The beta will be made available next week and an announcement will be posted.
Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Upcoming update news!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2bGiQEv.gif[/img]
Hi, so after watching play through's & gathering feedback there are a few things I wish to bring to the current game before releasing the next level and hopefully add more "replayability".

The tutorial section has had a graphical overhaul & more ability training sections added.

A new infiltration section will be added to the first map to prepare the player for action at a better pace than currently hang-gliding straight into battle. You will still hang-glide!

I feel having all abilities available from the beginning is causing them to be under utilized so I am working on a random drop system for ability usage adding variety to repeat play through's.

The gun will no longer have unlimited ammo, it will require recharging from enemy drops.

A new deflecting shield ability added to off-hand (see above).

This update will hopefully be ready for release next week.

notes.title: Snap turning for Oculus Touch owners is now available!
notes.content:
Notice: Cyberdrifter is and always was intended for 360 room scale (3 Oculus sensors required). This is stated in the VR support listing & the main description.

Snap turning is available for "Standing only" Oculus touch owners.

This allows re-orientation so that the player can always face the sensors if they don't have the 3 sensor set-up.

This is not the recommended method to use for turning during gameplay, preferably use the tilt method.

notes.title: The Trigger & Tilt control system in Cyberdrifter.
notes.content:
Cyberdrifter utilizes a unique style of movement control in VR.

Instead of using the trackpad directions for forward and side movement, Cyberdrifter utilizes the trigger pressure for movement speed and tilting of the controller for direction.

This allows full FPS style movement as in the ability to strafe, turn, reverse & dodge quickly and smoothly.

I hope you like it and look forward to any feedback that you may have.

Thanks.

notes.title: Cyberdrifter is releasing today at 6pm GMT!
notes.content:
Hi all, well the day has finally come and Cyberdrifter will be unleashed into early access today at 6pm GMT.

One of the main development goals was to see if a fast paced VR shooter with "FPS" style movement is possible in VR and I'm looking forward to feedback on the control style that I've gone for.

One more level is very close to completion but will not make it in time for the early access release date unfortunately, it should be ready very soon though!

The online leaderboard functionality is still being tweaked and will release alongside the new level.

Known issue with exiting the game.

Exiting out of the game via the Steam VR overlay will not function properly and  is a known issue with the engine build I developed on. I will migrate the game to a later engine build to solve this after the next level is released.

In the meantime hitting ESC will exit the game properly.

notes.title: Score system, online leaderboard, shield system & release news.
notes.content:
A score system and an online leaderboard are currently being added for the early access release.

Shield system - Cyberdrifter previously had a shield recharge system but during playtesting it was found to break the fast paced flow of the game as the player would tend to hang back waiting for it to recharge.

A new shield system has now been introduced in which enemies will leave behind shield energy top-ups that are on a timer, the quicker these are picked up will determine the amount of shield energy that is regained.

A new updated trailer will be released next week.

Cyberdrifter will be entering early access in May. Exact date tbd.
